start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:source-a-screen-from-design-libraries for a settings page with a row of notification toggles, on the web."
no_lists_because: Its steps name no list and write no row: each step answers in the run itself.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:source-a-screen-from-design-libraries", with need (The screen, flow or component wanted, in the person's words (for example a sign-up flow, a feedback form, a nested popover).); it starts it with tool:run-workflow-definition (row workflow:source-a-screen-from-design-libraries).
2. Look for the whole thing ready-made: done when fit is true with at least one component id read with get_component, or fit is false with the queries run and the near misses named.
3. See how real products do it: done when At least three cited examples and one anatomy list whose parts the next step can search for one by one.
4. Take each part from the component library: done when Every anatomy part has a component id or its queries and the shared component used instead.
5. Build it in the person's own look: done when The built thing is named by its path or address, and an after screenshot of the real result exists.
6. Judge it against the references: done when A passes verdict on the final screenshot, with the branch taken recorded.
7. Read what it gives back: A screen, flow or component built from cited library parts, with the component ids and product screen links it came from, and a judged before and after.

worked_examples.title: A whole ready-made fit is looked for first

input.need: a settings page with a row of notification toggles

worked_examples.given: Three searches of the component library: "settings page", "notification settings", "toggle list".
worked_examples.hands_back: fit true; queries ["settings page", "notification settings", "toggle list"]; components ["example/notification-settings-panel"].
